selection: Five existing Type I entries in counties without a published schedule.
method: Read full sources; match Ohio organization/address and preserve authorization fields. Promote only supported upcoming games. Record deferred checks as part of the five, not as completed game verification.

updates.name: Fourteenth Street Community Center

published.schedule: Wednesday and Thursday: doors 4:30 p.m.; Shamrock early bird 6 p.m.; regular bingo 6:30 p.m.
notes: Organizer advertises games at 2313 17th Street; the separate Jackson Street authorization is not assigned this schedule. Published contact is the community center office. Prices, attendance rules and accessibility require confirmation.

updates.finding: Organizer address matches the existing Type I entry. Only the 17th Street row is enriched.
updates.limitations: State authorization is not a current game guarantee; prices and access not established.

updates.name: American Legion #210

published.advertised_name: Celina Lake Festival Designer Purse Bingo · Legion 210
published.schedule: November 8, 2026: doors noon; first game 1 p.m. at the Celina American Legion.
notes: WCSM’s October 6, 2026 report attributes the announcement to the Celina-Mercer County Chamber. The November 8 date matches this venue’s October 2 state authorization. This is one advertised event, not weekly bingo.
Call or text Erin at the published event-ticket number, 419-733-3884. This is an event contact, not the Legion office. Confirm ticket availability, attendance rules and venue details.
The festival is the advertised event host; no separate license or legal-operating conclusion about the festival is inferred.

updates.finding: Dated local chamber reporting advertises November 8; existing state entry corroborates the date and Celina Legion venue.
updates.limitations: Current organizer flyer and ticket availability were not independently obtained. Event schedule comes from the attributed local report, not the festival homepage.

updates.name: Van Wert County Council On Aging

notes: The organizer’s public-event page lists 2025 events only and explicitly says bingo is not every Monday. No future charitable-game schedule is inferred from the 2026 authorization dates.

Separate senior-center activity page advertises penny bingo Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 9:30–10:30 a.m., and third-Wednesday nickel bingo, 12:30–2 p.m. These are senior activities, not confirmation of this licensed public-event schedule; ask the center about participation.

updates.finding: Public contact and correct organization/address matched. Old public-event dates not advanced to 2026.
updates.limitations: Senior activities retained separately in notes; no newly published upcoming charitable-game date.

updates.name: West Alexandria Firemen's Association, Inc.

notes: Village publishes the fire department office number at the same 25 E Dayton Street address. It is an inquiry route, not a dedicated bingo line. A current advertised game schedule remains unconfirmed.

updates.finding: Government directory corroborates fire-department address and public office contact.
updates.limitations: January 2026 winter event lead was not extrapolated to October; no source-backed current game dates.

deferred.name: Carey-Bavis Post 180 Carey Bavis American Legion Post 180
deferred.reason: A 2026 obituary mentions historical Friday attendance. Undated directories give 7:30 p.m., but no current organizer advertisement or independently current schedule was established. No game time, contact or new review date published.
